item.title: Boost Resume with Impactful Bullets 🚀 • Quantify results: Use numbers to show impact. • Use: “I increased sales by 30% in Q2.” • Start with a strong action verb. • Highlight unique contributions or initiatives. • Tailor each bullet to the job description.
